name: Simple as Snow
source:
Simple as Snow is a kinetic visual novel about a caster named Lysa who is caught up in the middle of a sorceress scheme to steal the heart of a young king. If only it were about love and not the sorceress' sick plot to literally take his heart.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240229144044/https://castingdreams.itch.io/simple-as-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Simple as Snow》是一部無選項視覺小說。施法者萊莎捲入一位女術士的陰謀，對方打算奪走年輕國王的心。要說是為了愛情倒好了，可她那病態計畫裡的「心」，指的真是國王胸腔裡的那一顆。

［摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240229144044/https://castingdreams.itch.io/simple-as-snow]itch.io[/url]］
